findings.statement: Home mixer public default VMRankerSendDebiasInputs changes from false to true; this only establishes transport input availability on this public path, not production request values.
VM ranker adds user debias parameters and recentering code, while UserDebiasEnabled defaults false and UserDebiasAlpha defaults 0.0; no universal live score change follows.
Content text metrics implementation is rewritten and includes reference-equivalence tests; feature existence does not establish a fixed author-side formatting bonus.
